ig_aciklama:
Patrona güldün, müşteriye güldün, kasiyere, apartman görevlisine... Bir günde tam 20 gülümseme. Eve gelince annen "hoş geldin" dedi, bir "hı" bile demedin. Bu akşam kapıdan girerken önce evdekilere gül. 🏠

Sen en son evde kime güldün? Yoruma yaz.
ig_aciklama_en:
You laughed at your boss's joke, smiled at the angry customer, the cashier, the doorman... Twenty smiles in one day. Then Mom said "Welcome home" and you didn't even say hi. Tonight, when you walk through that door, save your first smile for them. 🏠

Who was the last person you smiled at at home? Tell us in the comments.
yt_baslik_en: You Smile at Everyone... But at Home? #shorts
